reference_usage_guidance.purpose: Initial design references that support continued invention, not a closed catalog.
reference_usage_guidance.new_characters: Create new faces, builds, outfits, armor and weapons beyond these sheets while retaining species-defining anatomy, art direction and setting coherence.
reference_usage_guidance.exact_reuse: Reserve identity and signature-item matching for the same established character or an explicit reuse request; do not require it for new characters.
reference_usage_guidance.variation: Vary silhouette, cut, proportion, materials, craft, condition, role and taste; review against recent art for repeated faces and kit. Recoloring and small accessories alone are insufficient.
reference_usage_guidance.construction: Keep construction coherent and purposeful. Variety need not add layers, straps or ornament.
reference_usage_guidance.scope: No sample defines an entire people or faction. Historical prompts record sheet generation and do not limit future art.
reference_usage_guidance.gnosis: Broader steam-era craft with high-fantasy scholarly magic; optics are one option. Blue-enamel high-medieval breastplate is a positive material reference.
reference_usage_guidance.magic_balance: Magic is not dependent on equipment by default. People, creatures, imbued objects and industry can participate without a mandatory mechanism or visible caster connection.
reference_usage_guidance.scale_exploration: Explore varied scales and overlaps between alignments. No mechanical/magitech hovering vessels. Capacity, prevalence and faction approaches remain open.
reference_usage_guidance.effect_variety: Avoid defaulting to threads, ribbons and luminous connections; specific accepted loom/healer/cosmology examples remain valid.
reference_usage_guidance.magic_variety: The creator explicitly likes different types of magic. Continue varied expressions and uses across characters, creatures, rites, work and constructs; accepted examples remain starting points.
reference_usage_guidance.storm_touched_bull_scene: Bull design accepted; add supporting scene elements to bring energy in finished illustrations. Neutral study staging is not a finished-scene template.
reference_usage_guidance.tone: Separate subject/content approval from overall scene tone. Keep vivid color; avoid making pervasive purple, flowers and idyllic brightness the default. The strongly liked street goblin retains its vivid palette.
reference_usage_guidance.city_scale: Keep the world large and varied. A great city such as exploratory Ambrel can use magic to compensate for uneven industry and support selectively impressive capabilities such as constructs, without making all regions uniformly advanced or prosperous.
reference_usage_guidance.faces: Actually consult and use ordinary reference faces for corrective casting. Maintain varied proportions and attractiveness; occasional glamorous faces remain valid. References are starting points, not a closed cast.
reference_usage_guidance.rendering: Matte natural skin; material-specific reflectance; varied edges and brush scale matching local detail. Quiet distance without lens blur. Avoid waxy surfaces, hard fine lines under thick brush texture, and recurring red cheeks, especially on heavyset women.
reference_usage_guidance.frontline_casting: Predominantly men for new aggressive frontline fighters; female soldiers are occasional. Women remain welcome among mages, archers and other roles. Do not retroactively alter approved female characters without a specific request.
reference_usage_guidance.round07_approval: All seventeen corrections are accepted. Use the revised faces, measured detail, matte surfaces, mixed harbor armor and abstract construct as positive references; do not repeat them as a closed cast or uniform.
reference_usage_guidance.current_direction:
CASTING: For new highly aggressive frontline fighters, the vast majority should be men; female soldiers remain occasional. Women remain welcome as mages, archers, civilians and other characters. Preserve specifically approved identities unless the creator requests a change.

FACES: Actively consult the human/species face sheets. Use specific ordinary reference faces for corrective casting, and draw on their varied skulls, noses, jaws, ages and asymmetries when inventing new people. Keep generally appealing faces and occasional exceptional beauty; avoid repeated model faces, compulsory ugliness and uncanny skin detail.

MATERIALS: Skin, wool, wood and stone have naturally diffuse surfaces. Reserve stronger reflections for appropriate metal, glass or water. Avoid waxy faces, uniform surface shine and habitual red cheeks, especially on heavyset women. Keep vibrant color and convincing light.

PAINTED ATTENTION: Match brush size, edge precision and detail locally. Focal features can be precise; secondary people and distant places stay legible with fewer marks and quieter contrast. Do not combine coarse texture with uniformly hairline detail, render everything equally sharply, or substitute camera blur and tunnel focus.

DESIGN RANGE: Constructs may have abstract functional anatomy, asymmetry and open space; they need not resemble armored human knights. Gnosis combines scholarly high fantasy with broader steam-era craft, not an optics uniform. Blend selected Asian armor details into the established kit; modest curved eaves are a valid architectural option. These are examples, not mandatory formulas.

MAGIC AND PRESENTATION: Direct personal and creature magic, imbued objects and industrial applications can coexist without universal equipment, visible power feeds or glowing threads. Keep grounded steam machinery and creature/direct magical flight distinct from the rejected hovering magitech vessels. Choose a compelling image; card rules do not require an ability demonstration.

REFERENCE USE: Accepted references guide anatomy, materials, individual continuity and taste; they do not limit new faces, clothes, kit, settings or magic to a repeating catalog. Preserve accepted content and vary presentation. Feedback applies at the image or batch scope given unless the creator makes it general.
reference_usage_guidance.constructs: Abstract functional anatomy, asymmetry and open space are welcome; avoid defaulting to armored human knights.
reference_usage_guidance.cultural_influence: Blend selected Asian armor details into the established kit. Modest curved eaves are welcome as one architectural option; neither is a universal style.
reference_usage_guidance.painted_attention: Fine and broad brushwork must match local definition. Focused features can be precise; secondary figures and distance remain perceptible through fewer quieter marks, without camera blur.

equipment_design_slots_scope: The existing equipment-only sheets. New combined character/kit sheets are counted separately.
